name: Parallel scheduling and worker management
userOutcome: The user can run compatible work concurrently, see why tasks are or are not running, and avoid global waits, duplicate claims, or resource overload.
productionDataSource: Ready-task projection, workers, leases, resources, priorities, WIP rules, and scheduler events.
errorBehavior: Preserve leases and work, stop unsafe scheduling, reconcile before retry, and expose exact wait or failure reasons.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not schedule in global rounds.
acceptanceTests: Race two workers for one task.
Let one worker finish several short tasks while long tasks continue.
Start review before sibling tasks finish.
